section_1.refiner_commit_note: Recorded in this immediate follow-up bookkeeping commit once the refinement commit's own hash was known (a state file committed inside a commit cannot contain that same commit's hash) — the same non-self-referential pattern the critic's own state-only commit already used relative to the builder commit.
section_1.commit_subject: phase10(§1): CSS 3D technical spike and production Observatory shell
section_1.css_vs_r3f_result: CSS 3D selected; no production Three.js/R3F dependency (reconfirmed by the refiner pass, including recreated measurements)
section_1.note: The shell is built and proven via the owner-gated /dev/observatory-shell preview route only. Wiring it into /share and / is §2 per PHASE10.md; §1 (builder and refiner) deliberately did not widen scope to do that here.

last_green_commit_note: The `phase10(§1): refine critic findings` commit. Tests (291/291, 53 files) and production build (16 routes) were run by the Claude Refiner against that commit's exact working-tree content before committing; this bookkeeping-only follow-up commit records the resulting hash (see section_1.refiner_commit_note for why it couldn't be included in the refinement commit itself).

tests.summary: Claude Refiner ran the suite after all five findings were addressed and R3F/Playwright were removed again: 53 test files passed; 291 of 291 tests passed (was 51 files / 278 tests at the reviewed builder commit; +2 files / +13 tests: page.test.ts, observatory-contrast.test.ts, plus new cases in chapters.test.ts, ChapterOrbit.test.tsx, and observatory-fallback.test.ts).

build.summary: Claude Refiner ran the Next.js 16.2.11 production build after cleanup: compilation and TypeScript passed; 16 static-page tasks generated (same route count as the reviewed builder commit — /dev/phase10-spike-r3f was recreated for measurement and removed again before this build).
build.font_network_behavior: Unchanged from §0/§1: src/app/layout.tsx still imports Inter, JetBrains Mono, and Instrument Serif from next/font/google. Remains §13 work.
build.r3f_dependency_absent: Confirmed by direct inspection and `git diff --quiet package.json package-lock.json` (byte-identical to the pre-refiner commit): three, @react-three/fiber, @types/three, and the refiner's temporary measurement tool (playwright) are all absent from package.json, package-lock.json, and node_modules at the final commit.

visual.note: All 13 desktop/mobile screenshots across docs/phase10-spike-section-1/ and docs/phase10-baseline/section-1/ were recaptured with headless Playwright (page.setViewportSize, no resize floor) against a real production server, and every file's pixel dimensions were verified with `sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight` before being documented — full sips output is in DECISION.md. Every file now matches its filename/label exactly (previously: the shell public file labeled 1440x900 was 892x779, other desktop files labeled 1440x900 were 991x865, and mobile files were 614x667 substitutes).
visual.genuine_390_320_capture: Resolved this pass. Real 390x844 and 320x844 screenshots exist for the CSS spike, the R3F spike (390x844), and the production shell (public, and forced-no-3d-fallback at 390x844; public at 320x844). document.documentElement.scrollWidth === clientWidth (no horizontal overflow) was verified at every narrow capture.
visual.mobile_capture_limitation: Resolved. The original ~614-991px browser-extension resize floor no longer applies — headless Playwright reaches exact 390/320px viewports directly. See docs/phase10-spike-section-1/DECISION.md 'Mobile capture limitation — resolved this pass' for the full method.

accessibility.chapter_navigation: Unchanged from the reviewed builder commit: ObservatoryShell/ChapterOrbit provide real five-chapter semantic navigation (one <nav>, one real link per chapter, aria-current on the active one). Not yet wired into /share, /, or /dashboard (§2/§4/§6 do that) — expected, not a defect.
accessibility.focus: Unchanged: the active chapter's h2 (tabIndex=-1) receives a visible :focus-visible outline and is the focus-restoration target after a client-side chapter change.
accessibility.headings: Unchanged: exactly one h1 per shell instance.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Unchanged: pure CSS, verified by observatory-fallback.test.ts — now also asserting the concentric map's display:none/block toggle stays wired to the same reduced-motion/forced-no-3D selectors as every other fallback element.
accessibility.contrast: FIXED: .freshnessLabel's --obs-ink-faint token changed from #726d63 (3.82:1, the critic's measured failure) to #847e73 (4.88:1, computed via the standard WCAG relative-luminance formula and asserted by a new regression test, observatory-contrast.test.ts, that computes the ratio directly from source tokens).
accessibility.static_concentric_fallback: ADDED: a decorative, aria-hidden concentric-rings map (.concentricMap/.concentricRing/.concentricCenter) renders only in the fallback layout (narrow viewport, reduced motion, forced no-3D), highlighting the active chapter's ring. Additive only — the five real chapter links remain the only controls, reading order and 44px targets are unchanged, and ChapterOrbit.test.tsx asserts the map contains zero focusable elements (no duplicate focus stops).
known_issues: The shell is proven at /dev/observatory-shell only; production routes still lack it until later sections wire it in (unchanged from the reviewed builder commit; explicitly out of §1's scope per PHASE10.md).

privacy.logged_out_check: Both routes render the sign-in form with zero authentication cookie present (curl, no cookie jar) against the refiner's rebuilt production server. /dev/phase10-spike-r3f (recreated temporarily for measurement) returns a genuine 404 after cleanup — confirmed via curl.
privacy.public_dollar_leak_check: No $<digits>.<digits> pattern found in either retained route's unauthenticated HTML.
privacy.shell_cross_render_check: Unchanged: ObservatoryShell.test.tsx asserts the owner slot is never rendered in mode="public".
privacy.query_preservation_privacy_note: The new preservedQuery mechanism (fix for finding 2) only echoes back query keys the caller explicitly names (mode, no3d on the preview route) — verified live end-to-end against the rebuilt server (mode=private&no3d=1 survives all five chapter links) — it cannot smuggle unvetted query state into a link and carries no portfolio data.
privacy.local_auth_method: Temporary localhost-only OWNER_PASSWORD process override for the refiner's live screenshot/measurement capture and end-to-end privacy re-check; no environment-file contents were read at any point.

process_check.summary: Confirmed no other Claude/Codex process was active against this repository before the refiner pass began. All temporary local processes started for measurement (the production server on :3100) were stopped (verified via lsof) before the final commit.

failures.criterion: required measured and dimensionally accurate technical-spike evidence
failures.evidence: The decision omits measured load time, long tasks, frame stability, memory, and phone interaction latency. Files labeled 1440x900 are 892x779 or 991x865; committed mobile files are 614x667.
failures.required_change: Recreate both spikes long enough to record every required runtime metric and genuine 1440x900/390x844 evidence, verify dimensions, then remove R3F code/dependencies before commit.
failures.refiner_response: Recreated /dev/phase10-spike-r3f and its dependencies; measured load time, long tasks, frame stability, memory, and interaction latency with headless Playwright against a real production server; recaptured all 13 screenshots at genuine, sips-verified 1440x900/390x844/320x844 dimensions (full sips output recorded in DECISION.md); removed R3F and the temporary Playwright tooling again before this commit, confirmed via git diff --quiet and direct node_modules inspection.

failures.criterion: stable URL state across chapter navigation
failures.evidence: Chapter hrefs replace the query with only chapter. Clicking Forces from mode=private changed the preview to public; no3d=1 is also dropped.
failures.required_change: Preserve route-relevant query state while replacing only chapter.
failures.refiner_response: observatoryChapterHref() now accepts an optional preservedQuery map merged into the built URL before setting chapter; ChapterOrbit and ObservatoryShell thread it through; the /dev/observatory-shell preview route passes its mode/no3d params as preservedQuery. Verified live end-to-end against the rebuilt server: all five chapter links from ?mode=private&chapter=structure&no3d=1 correctly keep mode=private&no3d=1. New unit tests cover preservedQuery in chapters.test.ts and ChapterOrbit.test.tsx.

failures.criterion: retained evidence controls lead to valid destinations
failures.evidence: The retained CSS spike links to removed /dev/phase10-spike-r3f; the critic activated it and received 404.
failures.required_change: Link to durable R3F evidence/decision documentation or render historical context without a dead route link.
failures.refiner_response: /dev/phase10-spike-css no longer links to /dev/phase10-spike-r3f; it names the path as historical, non-interactive text pointing to DECISION.md. A source-level regression test (page.test.ts) asserts no href to the removed route exists.

failures.evidence: The freshness label computed to 3.82:1 at 12.8px/400.
failures.required_change: Raise freshness-label contrast to at least 4.5:1 while retaining hierarchy.
failures.refiner_response: --obs-ink-faint changed from #726d63 (3.82:1) to #847e73 (4.88:1, computed via the standard WCAG relative-luminance formula). A new regression test (observatory-contrast.test.ts) computes the ratio from source tokens directly.

failures.criterion: the exact selected Night Orbit static concentric fallback is present
failures.evidence: Forced, reduced-motion, and mobile fallback CSS produces only a rectangular vertical link strip and inspector; no static concentric map or equivalent spatial index exists.
failures.required_change: Add a restrained static concentric map sharing the existing semantic state and single link set without overflow or duplicate focus stops.
failures.refiner_response: Added a decorative, aria-hidden concentric-rings map that appears only in the fallback layout and highlights the active chapter's ring. Additive only: five real chapter links remain the only controls, 44px targets and reading order unchanged, zero focusable elements inside the map (asserted by ChapterOrbit.test.tsx). Visually confirmed in the recaptured forced-fallback screenshots at 1440x900 and 390x844.
